product_overview: GardenFood v2 helps registered users manage home orchards through guided onboarding, orchard planning, species guidance, and seasonal care tracking. The app also lets users maintain their profile and find recommended species based on their comuna.
core_goals: Sign in or register to access the orchard dashboard
Set up and organize one or more orchards and tree inventories
Plan tree placement in guided or modular orchard modes
Browse species, inspect care guidance, and record fertilizer application
Review recommended species and annual care schedules
Update profile details, privacy preferences, and account settings

features.name: Autenticación
features.description: Users can access the app with email and password, and protected dashboard routes redirect unauthenticated users to registration.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email credentials -> Enter password credentials -> Submit the login form -> See the orchard dashboard
Navigate to a protected dashboard route without a session -> See redirect to /registro with a next destination set -> Complete registration or sign in to continue to the requested area

features.name: Modo guiado del huerto
features.description: Users can follow a guided orchard overview that highlights pending positioning tasks, daily tasks, and species summaries with links to each species page.
user_flows: Navigate to /huerto -> See the guided orchard overview -> Review trees pending positioning -> Open the pending positioning action -> Continue to the positioning flow
Navigate to /huerto -> See the guided orchard overview -> Review today’s tasks -> Mark a task as done -> See the task update in the list
Navigate to /huerto -> See the guided orchard overview -> Review the species summary -> Open a species page from the summary -> See the selected species guidance
Navigate to /huerto -> See the guided orchard overview -> Switch to modular mode -> Return later and see the preferred mode preserved

features.name: Modo modular con lienzo
features.description: Users can work in a modular orchard workspace with grouped inventory, canvas tabs, an embedded satellite map, a 2D positioning matrix, and a 3D view.
user_flows: Navigate to /huerto -> See the modular orchard workspace -> Switch between the satellite, positioning matrix, and 3D tabs -> See the canvas content change with each tab
Navigate to /huerto -> See the modular orchard workspace -> Open the satellite terrain view -> Draw or edit an orchard polygon -> See the orchard area update on the map
Navigate to /huerto -> See the modular orchard workspace -> Expand a species row in the grouped inventory -> Review the individual trees under that species -> Collapse the row again
Navigate to /huerto -> See the modular orchard workspace -> Open the floating assistant -> View the 4-step orchard setup flow
Navigate to /huerto?huerto=<selected> -> See the workspace filtered to the chosen orchard -> Review only the matching inventory and canvas content

features.name: Ficha de especie con fertilización casera
features.description: Users can search for a species, open its detail page, review seasonal fertilizer guidance with home measurements, and record that they have applied it.
user_flows: Navigate to /especie/especies -> Type a species name in the search field -> See the matching cards update in real time -> Open a species card -> See the species detail page

Navigate to /especie/especies/[especie] -> Review the fertilizer program by growth stage -> Check home measurement doses and watering method -> Open the annual care calendar -> Review the INIA traceability notes
Navigate to /especie/especies/[especie] -> Review the fertilizer program -> Record that the fertilizer has been applied -> See the confirmation message and the next task scheduled

features.name: Perfil y mapa de terreno
features.description: Users can set their comuna, review their terrain on a map, manage privacy consent, and delete their account with a typed confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /perfil -> Choose a comuna -> Save the profile update -> See the comuna reflected in the profile
Navigate to /perfil -> Open privacy settings -> Review the consent options -> Manage the privacy preference -> See the updated consent state
Navigate to /perfil -> Open the delete-account dialog -> Type ELIMINAR -> Confirm deletion request -> See the account removal flow proceed
Navigate to /perfil -> Review the terrain map -> Inspect the mapped terrain area -> Return to profile settings

features.name: Especies recomendadas
features.description: Users can view species recommended for their comuna to help choose suitable plants.
user_flows: Navigate to /recomendadas -> Review the recommended species list -> Open a recommended species card -> See more details for that species
Navigate to /recomendadas -> Review the recommendations for the current comuna -> Compare the suggested species -> Use the information to plan planting choices

features.name: Calendario anual de cuidados
features.description: Users can view an annual care calendar organized by species to understand what to do throughout the year.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendario -> Review the annual care schedule -> Identify the tasks for each species -> Plan upcoming orchard care
Navigate to /calendario -> Review the calendar by species -> Compare seasonal care moments -> Decide which species need attention now

routes.description: Landing pública con selector de comuna y zona agroclimática
Inicio de sesión con correo y contraseña

Dashboard del huerto con dos modos (guiado y modular), asistente de 4 pasos, lienzo con tabs (terreno satélite / posicionar árboles / visualización 3D), inventario agrupado por especie y selector de huerto
Índice de especies con buscador y tarjeta-puente al asistente
Ficha de especie con programa de fertilización por momento, dosis caseras y botón Lo eché
Perfil de usuario con comuna, mapa de terreno, consentimiento de privacidad y eliminación de cuenta
Calendario anual de cuidados por especie

features.name: Modo guiado del huerto
features.description: Vista «¿Qué sigue hoy?» con pendientes de posicionamiento, tareas de la semana y resumen por especie con enlace a fichas
user_interactions: Ver pendientes de posicionamiento y click en Posicionar N pendientes
Ver tareas del día y marcarlas como hechas
Abrir ficha de especie desde el resumen por especie
Cambiar a modo modular con el toggle y que la preferencia persista

features.name: Modo modular con lienzo
features.description: Vista banco de trabajo con inventario agrupado por especie (badges en curso/completo), lienzo con tabs Terreno satélite / Posicionar árboles / Visualización 3D y asistente flotante
user_interactions: Dibujar/editar polígono del huerto en satélite embebido
Expandir fila de especie y ver ejemplares individuales
Filtrar por huerto con selector global ?huerto=

features.name: Ficha de especie con fertilización casera
features.description: Programa por momento (despierta/engorda/recupera), dosis en cucharadas y tazas, calendario anual, trazabilidad INIA y botón Lo eché que registra aplicación y agenda próxima tarea
user_interactions: Ver dosis caseras por momento y método de riego
Pulsar Lo eché y ver confirmación
Buscar especie en el índice y filtrar tarjetas

features.name: Perfil y mapa de terreno
features.description: Comuna del usuario, mapa satelital con dibujo de polígonos, ajustes de privacidad y eliminación de cuenta con confirmación por texto
user_interactions: Abrir modal Ajustes de privacidad con Gestionar
Abrir modal Eliminar mi cuenta (solo al click, escribir ELIMINAR)

features.name: Autenticación
features.description: Login/registro con Supabase Auth, protege rutas de dashboard
user_interactions: Ver redirección a /registro con next si no hay sesión

known_limitations.issue: El changelog del consentimiento (endpoint /api/v1/cmp/consent) devuelve 400 al rechazar todo en desktop
known_limitations.impact: El rechazo de cookies debería devolver 200; posible raíz de modal congelado en iOS/Safari

known_limitations.issue: La zona de la comuna puede discrepar con la zona de los huertos geolocalizados
known_limitations.impact: El header mezcla comuna del perfil (Maipú) con huertos en Ñuble
